content:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick sync — launching a small SI onboarding pilot next month focused on cloud marketplace listing + HW bundling for APAC. goal: 5 SIs, 3 training sessions, validated marketplace templates, and a cert badge pilot. RSVP in this thread if you're in.

Raj (Solutions): Love it. counting in. need clarity on HW voucher flow for partner labs — do we have a process yet?

Sarah (SI Ops): We have a draft voucher flow but not APAC localization. main gap: courier timelines for lab kits and customs paperwork. suggest we limit pilot to APAC hubs with faster clearance (SG/HKG).

Kevin (DevEx): I can prepare marketplace listing templates and a small README for SI engineers. would like to sync on required fields and sample screenshots.

Jess (Trainer): Training plan idea: 2 live sessions (biz+tech) and 1 self-paced lab. hands-on lab will use a preseeded VM image + quickstart script. also propose a short cert quiz (20 mins) and a badge on success.

Maya (Partnerships): Agenda for kickoff office hours (week 1):
```
- 10m: overview + goals
- 20m: marketplace listing walkthrough (Kevin)
- 20m: HW bundling & voucher ops (Sarah)
- 10m: training & cert plan (Jess)
- 10m: action items + owners
```
Please review and flag missing items.

Raj (Solutions): action: I can draft a minimal integration checklist for SI HW drives (power, NICs, drivers) and required testing matrix. ETA EOD Fri.

Sarah (SI Ops): I'll map courier partners and share an APAC-ready packing checklist. Also need a contact for customs invoice templates — @Maya can you share?

Maya (Partnerships): Assigned: Raj -> SI integration checklist; Kevin -> marketplace template + example screenshots; Sarah -> APAC courier + customs doc; Jess -> training deck + cert quiz; I'll coordinate partner comms and draft announcement cadence for joint blog + marketplace launch.

onboard-bot: Reminder: office-hours kickoff scheduled 2026-04-15 16:00 SGT. Add to calendar: https://cal.example.com/meet/si-onboard-kickoff

Kevin (DevEx): Quick Q — do we want the marketplace listing to include cost tiers (dev / production / enterprise) or keep it single SKU for pilot? My vote: single SKU to reduce friction.

Jess (Trainer): Single SKU for pilot + optional add-ons (onboarding workshop). Cert badge pass threshold: 80%. thoughts?

Raj (Solutions): Agree single SKU. 80% pass sounds fair. Also propose we create a short eval prompt set to validate model quality post-deploy.

Maya (Partnerships): Consensus: single SKU pilot, 80% badge threshold. Next steps: everyone drop one PR (template/checklist/deck/lab image) to the shared repo by Tue EOD so we can rehearse. I'll send calendar invites and a simple partner-facing FAQ doc draft by end of day. :thumbsup:

Sarah (SI Ops): Noted. I'll start customs/invoice template and ping legal if needed.

Raj (Solutions): PR coming.

Kevin (DevEx): will upload templates to repo and include screenshot mockups.

Jess (Trainer): will publish training schedule + quiz link.

Maya (Partnerships): Thanks team — this pilot should help tighten the playbook for broader SI enablement and HW partner coordination. If anyone can't make the kickoff, drop notes here or DM me.

onboard-bot: Thread locked for follow-ups: please file action items in the repo issue tracker (labels: si-pilot, apac, hw-marketplace).
